levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Warm-up misses one of the two genuinely missing/incomplete items from Jordan's checklist.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Warm-up correctly identifies both the missing second reference and the not-started personal statement.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Warm-up also notes that the transcript, though 'requested,' is not yet confirmed received, showing attention to status nuance.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Drafted message(s) omit a deadline, a specific helpful detail, or both.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both drafted messages include a clear deadline and at least one specific, useful detail.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Messages are also appropriately tailored to their different recipients (reference-giver vs. trusted adult), not interchangeable templates.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a general difficulty without connecting it to a specific part of the practiced skill.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection names one specific part of the process as hardest and gives a real reason.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection's reasoning is specific enough to suggest a concrete way the learner could prepare for that difficulty.

lookFors: No real transcript, grade, school name, or personal academic record appears anywhere in the response.
Lead-time estimates are realistic (a reference typically needs more notice than printing a transcript).
The two drafted messages are addressed to clearly different recipients and are not near-duplicates of each other.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
